{
  "findings": [
    {
      "title": "Restrict email:send scope to send tool only",
      "body": "isAuthorized grants any email.* gated tool when the caller presents email:send, so isAuthorized('email.accounts.delete','email:send') returns true and a send-only token can delete an account and its drafts/outbox/cache via deleteAccount. The manifest describes delete as requiring admin/profile:write_danger, so send scope must not imply delete.",
      "priority": 1,
      "confidence": 0.9,
      "file_path": "mcp/src/auth.ts",
      "line_start": 336,
      "line_end": 345
    },
    {
      "title": "Scope draft update and readback by account",
      "body": "saveDraft looks up the draft by id alone, then runs UPDATE WHERE id AND account_id, then reads back by id alone. Reusing an id owned by another account makes the UPDATE affect zero rows and returns the other account's row unchanged, so the caller sees a successful save of stale foreign data while nothing was written.",
      "priority": 1,
      "confidence": 0.85,
      "file_path": "src/main/email/manager.ts",
      "line_start": 210,
      "line_end": 219
    },
    {
      "title": "Scope flags cache update by folder",
      "body": "setMessageFlags selects and updates email_messages_cache by account_id and uid only, but UIDs are folder-scoped and the cache key is (account_id, folder, uid). With the same UID present in INBOX and Sent, flagging one folder reads and rewrites the other folder's row, corrupting cached seen/flagged state.",
      "priority": 2,
      "confidence": 0.85,
      "file_path": "src/main/email/manager.ts",
      "line_start": 340,
      "line_end": 349
    }
  ],
  "overall_correctness": "incorrect",
  "overall_explanation": "Patch adds real mail-profile value but ships a send-scope privilege overreach plus two account/folder scoping defects that silently corrupt or leak drafts and flags. Lean already.",
  "overall_confidence_score": 0.85
}

Providers cannot thread on UID and the header is not a valid Message-ID, breaking reply threading for every reply/forward.", "priority": 2, "confidence": 0.85, "file_path": "src/renderer/src/pages/Email.tsx", "line_start": 210, "line_end": 219}, {"title": "Forward null profile filter as empty, not \"null\"", "body": "MCP email.accounts.list maps args.profile_id via String(), turning null into the literal `\"null\"`, so filtering for unbound accounts queries profile_id='null' and returns nothing. The SDK maps null to '' and the REST route maps '' to IS NULL, so the MCP path is the inconsistent outlier.", "priority": 2, "confidence": 0.8, "file_path": "mcp/src/tools.ts", "line_start": 603, "line_end": 612}], "overall_correctness": "incorrect", "overall_explanation": "Search against real IMAP servers and reply threading are broken as described above; fix those before merge. Dual camelCase/snake_case shapes are consumed on both sides, so no deletion applies. Lean already.", "overall_confidence_score": 0.83}

reviewer.report:
{
  "findings": [
    {
      "title": "Decode quoted-printable bodies as UTF-8 bytes, not chars",
      "body": "decodeTransferEncoding in src/main/email/manager.ts maps each =XX escape through String.fromCharCode, so multi-byte UTF-8 (e.g. Cyrillic =D0=9F) becomes two Latin-1 chars instead of one decoded character. Triggers on any quoted-printable non-ASCII body, garbling message view text. Fix collects bytes and decodes once as UTF-8. Replacement is the Buffer-based loop below.",
      "priority": 1,
      "confidence": 0.85,
      "file_path": "src/main/email/manager.ts",
      "line_start": 592,
      "line_end": 601,
      "suggestion": "  if (normalized === 'quoted-printable') {\n    const noSoftBreaks = content.replace(/=\\r?\\n/g, '');\n    const bytes: number[] = [];\n    for (let i = 0; i < noSoftBreaks.length; i++) {\n      if (noSoftBreaks[i] === '=' && /[0-9A-Fa-f]{2}/.test(noSoftBreaks.slice(i + 1, i + 3))) {\n        bytes.push(parseInt(noSoftBreaks.slice(i + 1, i + 3), 16));\n        i += 2;\n      } else {\n        for (const b of Buffer.from(noSoftBreaks[i], 'utf8')) bytes.push(b);\n      }\n    }\n    return Buffer.from(bytes).toString('utf8');\n  }"
    },
    {
      "title": "Preserve explicit null SMTP overrides in MCP dispatch",
      "body": "mcp/src/tools.ts maps email.accounts.create/update smtp_port via Number(args.smtp_port) and smtp_secure via Boolean(args.smtp_secure) whenever defined, so an explicit null (SDK types allow null for auto) becomes 0 and false. Triggers when clearing a custom SMTP override over MCP; stored port 0 breaks send and false overrides auto TLS. Fix forwards null as null. Replacement is the null-preserving mapping below.",
      "priority": 2,
      "confidence": 0.8,
      "file_path": "mcp/src/tools.ts",
      "line_start": 615,
      "line_end": 624,
      "suggestion": "        if (args.smtp_port !== undefined) body.smtp_port = args.smtp_port === null ? null : Number(args.smtp_port);\n        if (args.smtp_secure !== undefined) body.smtp_secure = args.smtp_secure === null ? null : Boolean(args.smtp_secure);"
    },
    {
      "title": "Escape backslashes in IMAP search literals",
      "body": "listMessages in src/main/email/manager.ts builds TEXT \"q\" by escaping only double quotes, but RFC 3501 quoted-string also escapes backslash. Triggers on search queries containing a backslash, producing a malformed UID SEARCH that the server rejects and drops to stale cache. Fix escapes backslashes before quotes. Replacement is the single line below.",
      "priority": 3,
      "confidence": 0.75,
      "file_path": "src/main/email/manager.ts",
      "line_start": 782,
      "line_end": 789,
      "suggestion": "      const searchCriteria = standardKeywords.test(q) ? q : `TEXT \"${q.replace(/\\\\/g, '\\\\\\\\').replace(/\"/g, '\\\\\"')}\"`;"
    }
  ],
  "overall_correctness": "incorrect",
  "overall_explanation": "Patch adds a large mail surface that is structurally sound (auth tiers, redaction, folder-aware cache, threading by Message-ID), but three patch-introduced defects need fixes before merge: QP UTF-8 mojibake, MCP null SMTP coercion, and IMAP search backslash escaping. Lean already.",
  "overall_confidence_score": 0.8
}
